top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) credits the full chain that changed medicine: the incretin and GLP-1 physiology, and the acylation-based protraction that overcame the minutes-long half-life of the native hormone and produced liraglutide and semaglutide with confirmed outcome benefit in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease. Mojsov's characterization of GLP-1(7-36) is real but its necessity and priority relative to the Habener group cannot be settled from the supplied record, so I would not rest a third slot on it. P002 is a defensible basic-science trio and ranks second, well above no award because the achievement is mature and independently confirmed.
